candidates.explanation: The size check uses `<` instead of `>`. Files smaller than file.maxFileSize (such as a 200 KB png) throw 413 'File too large'. Files at or above the limit (such as 20 MB) pass and get a signed URL. The comparison is inverted.

fix.description: Invert the comparison so that it throws only when fileSize exceeds the configured maximum: `file.fileSize > (maxFileSize || 0)`. Also consider skipping the check when maxFileSize is unset, because `|| 0` would then reject every file.
